2609.02247.title: SAUF-Net: Structure--Appearance Representation Learning with Uncertainty Feedback for Semi-Supervised Medical Image Segmentation
2609.02247.paper_summary: Semi-supervised learning has shown great potential for reducing annotation costs in medical image segmentation. However, most existing methods mainly exploit unlabeled data through prediction-level consistency, while the reliability of internal feature representations is often overlooked. In medical images, target-related structural cues are easily entangled with unstable appearance variations, which may lead to unreliable pseudo labels and error accumulation during training. To address these issues, we propose SAUF-Net, a Structure--Appearance Representation Learning with Uncertainty Feedback Network for semi-supervised medical image segmentation. SAUF-Net uses the Structure--Appearance Decomposition Module (SADM) to separate bottleneck features into structural and appearance representations. The Disentangled Guidance Module (DGM) injects these representations into the decoding process to enhance structure-aware segmentation. Meanwhile, the Auxiliary Decoder produces branch-specific predictions for reliability estimation and a fused prediction for appearance-swapped consistency. Furthermore, we introduce an Appearance-Swapped Consistency branch to encourage structural representations to remain stable under appearance variations. We also introduce a reliability-map-guided dual-head discriminator with a Validity Head and an Uncertainty Head to provide feature-level uncertainty feedback. Extensive experiments on ISIC-2016 and Kvasir-SEG demonstrate that SAUF-Net outperforms state-of-the-art semi-supervised methods, especially under low-label settings.
2609.02247.paper_summary_zh: 半監督學習在減少醫學影像分割的標註成本方面顯示出巨大的潛力。<lb/>然而，大多數現有方法主要通過預測級一致性來利用未標註數據，而內部特徵表示的可靠性往往被忽視。<lb/>在醫學影像中，與目標相關的結構線索容易與不穩定的外觀變化交織在一起，這可能導致不可靠的偽標籤和訓練過程中的錯誤累積。<lb/>為了解決這些問題，我們提出了SAUF-Net，一種帶有不確定性反饋的結構-外觀表示學習網絡，用於半監督醫學影像分割。<lb/>SAUF-Net使用結構-外觀分解模塊（SADM）將瓶頸特徵分離為結構和外觀表示。<lb/>解耦指導模塊（DGM）將這些表示注入解碼過程中，以增強結構感知的分割。<lb/>同時，輔助解碼器生成特定於分支的預測，以進行可靠性估計，並生成融合預測以實現外觀交換一致性。<lb/>此外，我們引入了一個外觀交換一致性分支，以鼓勵結構表示在外觀變化下保持穩定。<lb/>我們還引入了一個基於可靠性圖的雙頭鑑別器，具有有效性頭和不確定性頭，以提供特徵級的不確定性反饋。<lb/>在ISIC-2016和Kvasir-SEG上進行的廣泛實驗表明，SAUF-Net在低標籤設置下優於最先進的半監督方法。
